cases.case_label: Founder SVA in TAF1 with (CCCTCT)n repeat (XDP)
cases.mechanism_detail: The XDP-causing SVA insertion in TAF1 contains a hexanucleotide repeat whose length inversely correlates with age at onset and with TAF1 expression in blood, implying repeat-dependent TAF1 repression; the repeat is unstable across transmissions and somatically mosaic in brain.
cases.quote: RN-dependent TAF1 repression and subsequent differences in TAF1 mRNA levels in patients may be potentiated in the brain through somatic variability leading to the neurological phenotype.
